name: THE UNDERTAKER'S
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE GOOD SUIT
LOOK_AT: One good suit, in three sizes, rented for viewings and returned after. Half the men in Boot Hill were photographed in it. It has more friends than I do.
Three sizes, on one hanger, and all three have been let out at the waist.
It hangs better than most of the men who wore it. The suit, at least, has kept its shape.
LISTEN_TO: Wool, on a hanger, at rest. It has heard every eulogy in town and improved none of them.

overrides.PICK_UP: It is rented, and I am not the size.
overrides.USE: Renting it while alive is, I'm told, 'irregular but not unprecedented.' I did not ask about the precedent.

subjects.name: THE COFFINS
LOOK_AT: Three on trestles: pine, pine with handles, and pine with handles and a name plate. The tiers of Consolation, laid out plainly for once.
Coffins, stacked by size. There are a great many in the smallest size, which I have decided to attribute to storage efficiency.
Six months of work, standing ready. He is not expecting a quiet year.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. Naturally nothing. I don't know what I expected.

overrides.USE: Trying one for size is free. I know because I asked, which tells you what this town has done to my sense of thrift.
overrides.OPEN: There is nothing in it. I have checked, which I regret.

subjects.name: THE TEETH
LOOK_AT: A jar of teeth. I asked whose. He said, and I am quoting, 'various.'
A jar of teeth. He sells them on to the barber, who fits them to the living. Nothing in this establishment is wasted.
Still there. I have decided to think of it as inventory.
There are more than there were on Tuesday. I am not going to develop this thought.
LISTEN_TO: They shift when the floor does. I wish they would not.
Nothing. Obviously nothing. I checked, and I regret it.
Nothing. I have satisfied myself and I should like that to be the end of it.

overrides.USE: I have teeth. It is among my few unencumbered assets.

subjects.name: THE MEASURING WALL
LOOK_AT: Heights penciled on the door frame, like a family kitchen, except for what the measurements are for. I am between two men I never met.
Each mark has a name and a date beside it. The dates are all endings.
The tallest mark is a foot above my head and reads BIG SWEDE. He stooped through that door for years, and then he did not have to.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. The wall takes your measure and keeps it.
Nothing. It learns one thing about each man, and it is in no hurry to learn mine.

overrides.TALK_TO: I congratulated the wall on its discretion. It has the measure of everyone and repeats nothing.

subjects.name: THE VIEWING TABLE
LOOK_AT: Scrubbed oak, scrubbed often. The cleanest surface in the territory, for the least demanding clients.
Scrubbed to the grain, and scrubbed again since.
There is a block at one end for the head. It is padded. Somebody thought of that, and I am grateful to him on behalf of strangers.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing at all. Not even the wind bothers.

subjects.name: THE LEDGER OF ACCOUNTS
LOOK_AT: Burials on credit. The undertaker is owed by more of Boot Hill than the bank is, and he collects with more patience.
Every burial in Consolation. Eleven pages. Two thousand people have lived here for twelve years and it is eleven pages, which means most of them left.
Eleven pages in twelve years, in a town of two thousand.
Which means most of them left. I have been telling myself that all morning.
LISTEN_TO: A page lifts and lies back down. Somebody's balance.

subjects.name: THE FLOWERS, WAXED
LOOK_AT: Wax lilies, used at every service and dusted between them. Real flowers die, which is considered to be in poor taste here.
Dusted so often the wax has worn thin at the tips. Even the permanent arrangements are wearing out.
Somebody has painted a dewdrop on one petal. It is the only tear the arrangement has ever shed, and it is paint.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. They are beyond all that.
A faint click when the vase is touched. Wax petals, settling against each other.
Nothing. No bee has been fooled, and no bee has tried.

subjects.name: THE HEARSE HARNESS
LOOK_AT: Black harness on a peg, kept supple. The undertaker has no horse of his own; he borrows Grievance, who wears black well and knows the route.
The brass fittings are blacked over. Even the buckles are in mourning.
It is cut for Grievance and nobody else. She knows the road to Boot Hill, he says, and does not stop at the gate unless asked.
LISTEN_TO: Leather, easing on the peg. Working clothes between shifts.
A buckle ticking against the wall, patient as a mule.
Nothing. It is not a working day, and the harness can tell.

subjects.name: THE PRICE BOARD
LOOK_AT: Prices, chalked: the suit, the plate, the words said over you at three grades of sincerity. The top grade is surprisingly reasonable.
Plain, Respectable, and Handsome. The Handsome is four times the Plain and the difference is a handle.
There is a fourth line, scratched out, that began with the word Gratis.
Nobody has ever asked me which I would want, and I have decided that is a courtesy.
LISTEN_TO: Chalk dust. Commerce, at its most certain.

overrides.PICK_UP: It is nailed up, and I would rather not be seen taking it.

subjects.name: THE TOOLS
LOOK_AT: A saw, a plane, a brace, and a mallet, hung level and clean. This is a carpenter's shop that has specialized.
The plane has been used this morning. There are shavings and they are pale.
He makes them himself. I had assumed they came from somewhere.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. He is not working while I am standing here.

overrides.PICK_UP: They are hung level. I am not the man who unhangs them.

subjects.name: THE WAITING BENCH
LOOK_AT: A bench by the door, for those come to arrange things. It has a cushion.
Somebody put a cushion on a bench in an undertaker's. I would like to know who and I am not going to ask.
It is worn in the middle, which is the opposite of the Registrar's.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. It is the quietest bench in the territory and it has earned it.

overrides.USE: I have sat down. It is a very good cushion and that is somehow the worst part.

subjects.name: THE WINDOW
LOOK_AT: North light, and a blind half down. He works by it and he does not want watching.
The glass is clean. Everything in here is clean.
Boot Hill is that way, up the rise. You can see the markers from this window and he has left the blind so you can.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. The street, a long way off, and not much of it.

subjects.name: THE STREET DOOR
LOOK_AT: The door out. There is no bell, and I understand the decision.
It opens onto a lane rather than the street. He is not on Main Street and he is not hiding either.
The step is scrubbed. Of course the step is scrubbed.
